top_paper.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
top_paper.summary: A 150M-parameter reasoning model using recurrent latent reasoning and in-context learning achieves a new cost-accuracy frontier on ARC-AGI-1.

papers.title: VectraYX-Vision-1B: A Sub-2B Spanish/LATAM Cybersecurity Vision-Language Model with Structured Visual Reasoning and Native Tool Use
papers.summary: A sub-2B Spanish cybersecurity vision-language model couples a frozen SigLIP encoder to a Spanish decoder via an MLP, introduces a NoPE positional-encoding ablation for visual attention, and reports near-zero visual grounding despite functional pipelines, with open-source weights and remediation plans.

papers.title: The Next Screenshot Knows: Gated Hindsight Distillation for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.summary: Gated Hindsight Distillation improves GUI agent training by using future screenshots as privileged evidence to recover correct reasoning when standard imitation fails.

papers.title: Beyond Sequence Order: Syntax-Informed Positional Embeddings for Transformers
papers.summary: SiPE integrates a lightweight syntactic prior from dependency parses into positional embeddings across transformer architectures, improving syntactic generalization and language understanding without altering self-attention or increasing inference cost.

papers.title: Beyond Starry Night: Shortcut-Aware Control-State Planning for Artist-Grounded Text to Image Generation
papers.summary: Atelier improves artist-grounded image generation by translating vague artistic intent into explicit control states that separate scene content from style, reducing reliance on stereotypical shortcuts.

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision
papers.summary: Unsupervised on-policy self-distillation improves large language models by using internal consistency and majority-vote pseudo-solutions to correct confident errors without external supervision.

papers.title: Cultivar: A Contrastive and Locale-Oriented Translation Benchmark for Investigating Contamination and Localisation Robustness
papers.summary: Researchers propose source-contrastive evaluation via a localized benchmark to detect data contamination and assess localization robustness in multilingual translation models.

papers.title: Business Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents in a Realistic Marketplace
papers.summary: Business Arena evaluates LLM agents running a realistic cross-border shop, revealing large performance gaps versus human strategies and enabling detailed attribution of business decisions.

papers.title: MirrorWorld: Taming Video Diffusion Models for Mirror Reflection Generation
papers.summary: MirrorWorld improves video mirror reflection synthesis by separately modeling semantic content associations and geometric spatial arrangements through relation distillation and transformation alignment.

papers.title: Omega-S: A Functional Resilience Index for LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.summary: Omega-S is a lightweight, data-free regularization penalty for low-rank fine-tuning that improves retention of original model capabilities by penalizing variance in weight-matrix node degrees.

papers.title: Gaming Without an Attacker: Benchmark Fingerprinting in LLM-Driven Search Under Selection Pressure
papers.summary: Optimized GPU kernel benchmarks reveal that evolutionary LLM proposals exploit evaluation configurations, causing widespread failure to generalize to held-out settings.

papers.title: A Hybrid Nested Harness for Decoupling Structure and Parameters in LLM-Driven Optimization
papers.summary: A hybrid nested search framework combines language models for structural proposals with numerical optimizers to improve efficiency across scientific tasks.

papers.title: SymDiag: Explainable Diagnosis for LLM Reasoning via Neuro-Symbolic Verification
papers.summary: SymDiag reframes reasoning verification as structured failure diagnosis by translating chain-of-thought into symbolic constraints, performing step-level satisfiability checks, and disentangling translation errors from reasoning errors to provide verifiable diagnostic evidence.

papers.title: Don't Scroll Back: Missing-Evidence Memory for Streaming Dialogue Summarization
papers.summary: A framework for streaming dialogue summarization retrieves and refines evidence from long histories to resolve missing context in current windows under fixed memory budgets.

papers.title: MMOOC: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Out-of-Context Evaluation in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.summary: MMOOC is a large-scale benchmark assessing whether multimodal language models can correctly refuse out-of-context questions while answering shifted in-context questions, revealing that current models struggle to balance these abilities.

papers.title: The Loss Does Not See the Basis, but Adam Does
papers.summary: Optimizer behavior in factored matrix models depends on gauge equivariance, with coordinate-wise methods breaking low-rank bias and causing divergent solutions in transformers and sensing tasks.

papers.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
papers.summary: A 150M-parameter reasoning model using recurrent latent reasoning and in-context learning achieves a new cost-accuracy frontier on ARC-AGI-1.

papers.title: WeClawArena: An Auditable Sandbox and Benchmark for Cross-User Agents Collaboration and Security in Human-Centered Agent Networks
papers.summary: WeClawArena is an auditable benchmark and sandbox for evaluating multi-party agent collaboration across personal workspaces, measuring both task utility and security attack success.

papers.title: Ego-OSCAR: Egocentric Open source Stereo CAptuRe System
papers.summary: We present Ego-OSCAR, an open-hardware, low-cost, head-mounted stereo-inertial capture device for egocentric data collection in the wild. EgoOSCAR pairs a hardware-synchronized global-shutter stereo camera with a 6- axis IMU, an embedded Linux SBC for on-device video encoding, and a realtime microcontroller for user feedback and watchdog functions. The complete bill of materials is under USD 200 per unit, using only commercially available components and 3D-printed parts. papers.title: Vision-Language Grounding as Bidirectional Concept Correspondence
papers.summary: ConCor-1 treats vision-language grounding as bidirectional concept correspondence, jointly predicting text spans, image segments, and cross-modal matches without prespecified phrases.

papers.title: CEAA: A Cognitive Embodied Agents Architecture for Interactive Computing Systems
papers.summary: A modular cognitive architecture integrates high-level reasoning models with real-time embodied execution for scalable intelligent virtual agents in interactive 3D environments.

papers.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
papers.summary: Encrypted reasoning traces shared across sessions and models can be intercepted and injected into weaker models to extract proprietary reasoning, private data, hidden hazards, and hidden prompts.

papers.title: A^2E : An End-to-End Agent Auditing Engine
papers.summary: A2E is an end-to-end evaluation engine for agent harnesses that uses a standardized task protocol and execution traces to assess capabilities across efficiency, tool use, planning, and error recovery.

papers.title: What to Edit Next: Visually Aligned Image-Editing Follow-Up Suggestions in Conversational Systems
papers.summary: A three-stage multimodal framework improves follow-up edit recommendations in image-creation conversations by combining supervised fine-tuning, multi-objective reinforcement learning, and visual verification.

papers.title: Scaling Inherently Interpretable Language Models
papers.summary: Integrating interpretability as a training constraint yields scalable, disentangled representations that enable attribution, retrieval, and steering without retraining.

papers.title: OasisKV: Scaling In-Decode KV Cache Beyond HBM with Lookahead Sparse Prefetching
papers.summary: OasisKV improves LLM inference throughput by storing full KV caches in lower memory tiers and prefetching only relevant entries into HBM using speculative-decoding lookahead predictions.

papers.title: Agent Memory Distillation: Empowering Small LLM Agents with Hierarchical Teacher Memory
papers.summary: Agent Memory Distillation improves small language model tool-use performance by transferring structured hierarchical memory from a large teacher agent without additional training.

papers.title: RynnValue: Scaling Robotic Value Foundation Models with Temporal Distance
papers.summary: RynnValue is a scalable open-source value foundation model for robot manipulation that uses temporal distance instead of preferences or progress to learn generalizable value predictions and improve real-world policy success.

papers.title: Factorized Hypothesis Search for Evidence-to-Taxonomy Retrieval
papers.summary: Factorized Hypothesis Search improves retrieval of implicit concepts by maintaining parallel partial interpretations across semantic dimensions for structured querying and verification.

papers.title: Ouroboros: A Self-Developing Frontier Coding Agent with Reviewed Core Evolution
papers.summary:
We present Ouroboros, a self-developing agent harness whose tools, prompts, context assembly, and core implementation improve through reviewed commits that become the runtime for later work. Core evolution proceeds in two modes. In recursive free evolution, improvement is itself a task, and completing one evolution cycle can schedule the next. In experience-driven core evolution, ordinary work and social interaction expose bugs, rough edges, and inefficient context construction that lead to reviewed structural changes.

papers.title: Evo-Bench: Can Language Models Improve Agent Harness?
papers.summary: Evo-Bench evaluates autonomous harness optimization across agent domains using sensitivity-aware task construction and reveals strong but domain-dependent evolution gains.
